PolitiqueConfidentialite.title: Privacy Policy
PolitiqueConfidentialite.intro: This policy explains what personal information KO-LAB Inc. collects on this site, why, and how it is protected.
PolitiqueConfidentialite.section1_texte: This policy applies to the ko-lab-center.ca website, operated by KO-LAB Inc., a field deployment, fabrication and logistics company based in Outaouais, Quebec. For any question about this policy or your information, write to us at {courriel} or use our contact form.
PolitiqueConfidentialite.section2_texte: Depending on your interactions with the site, we may collect: your name, email address and phone number (contact form, account creation, order); your organization's name (contact, order); your delivery address (order with shipping); your password, stored encrypted by our authentication provider, never in plain text; your résumé and application information (careers form); the content of your exchanges in the chat bubble, if you use it.
PolitiqueConfidentialite.section3_texte: This information is used solely to respond to your requests, process your orders and quotes, manage your client account, review your application, and keep you informed of an order's progress. We never use it for advertising purposes and never sell it to anyone.
PolitiqueConfidentialite.section4_texte: KO-LAB Inc. does not sell or rent your information. Certain technical providers have access to it to allow us to operate the site: Supabase (database, authentication and file storage), Resend (sending transactional emails such as order confirmation), Vercel (site hosting) and Cloudflare (domain name management). If the chat bubble is enabled, Crisp hosts the conversations. Each of these providers acts as a processor, solely within the scope of operating the site — none may use your information for its own purposes.
PolitiqueConfidentialite.section5_texte: The site places a necessary technical cookie to keep your session open when you're logged into your account — nothing more is used for audience measurement or advertising. If the Crisp chat bubble is active, it may place its own cookies to remember your conversation.
PolitiqueConfidentialite.section6_texte: Your information is kept for as long as necessary for the purpose for which it was collected: as long as your account remains active, the time needed to process an order or application, or until you request its deletion.
PolitiqueConfidentialite.section7_texte: Under Quebec's Act respecting the protection of personal information in the private sector, you may request access to your information, its correction, or the withdrawal of your consent to its use, by writing to {courriel}. You may also file a complaint with the Commission d'accès à l'information du Québec if you believe your rights have not been respected.
PolitiqueConfidentialite.section8_texte: We apply reasonable measures to protect your information: role-restricted access, passwords never stored in plain text, and encrypted communications (HTTPS). No security measure is infallible; in the event of an incident affecting your information, we will inform you in accordance with the law.
PolitiqueConfidentialite.section9_texte: We may update this policy from time to time. The last-updated date at the top of this page indicates the version in effect.

ConditionsUtilisation.title: Terms of Use
ConditionsUtilisation.intro: By using this site, you accept the terms described below.
ConditionsUtilisation.section1_texte: Accessing and using the ko-lab-center.ca website constitutes full acceptance of these terms. If you do not accept these terms, please do not use the site.
ConditionsUtilisation.section2_texte: This site presents KO-LAB Inc.'s capabilities — field operations, installations, fabrication at The LAB, equipment — and allows you to submit a price request for a shop product or an equipment rental. The site does not process any online payment: prices shown are indicative and are confirmed directly by our team before any firm order.
ConditionsUtilisation.section3_texte: Creating an account requires an accurate name and email address. You are responsible for the confidentiality of your password and for any activity carried out from your account. Notify us promptly if you suspect unauthorized access.
ConditionsUtilisation.section4_texte: Submitting an order or a price request does not constitute a concluded sale: our team follows up with you to confirm availability, final price and terms. A submitted order can be modified during the window indicated on the confirmation; after that period, preparation begins.
ConditionsUtilisation.section5_texte: The text, photos, logos and other content on this site belong to KO-LAB Inc. or are used with the permission of their owners. Any reproduction without written authorization is prohibited.
ConditionsUtilisation.section6_texte: You agree not to use the site for unlawful purposes, not to attempt to bypass its security measures, and not to disrupt its normal operation.
ConditionsUtilisation.section7_texte: The site is provided as is, without warranty of continuous availability. KO-LAB Inc. cannot be held liable for indirect damages arising from the use of the site, to the extent permitted by law.
ConditionsUtilisation.section8_texte: These terms are governed by the laws of the Province of Quebec and the applicable laws of Canada.
ConditionsUtilisation.section9_texte: These terms may be updated from time to time. The date at the top of this page indicates the version in effect.
ConditionsUtilisation.section10_texte: For any question about these terms, write to {courriel} or use our contact form.
